title: MaleTheme Solo #014 · 남 클래식 머슬·실버 포일·닌자 테마·무늬
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in the ancient Parthenon terrace on the Acropolis in Athens, pale weathered marble paving, fluted columns and standard-height stone steps, empty of tourists, bright and evenly lit with crisp defined shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as him, NO dark background NO black void, ONE person standing, sharp focus from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, under hard direct flash lighting, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

SUBJECT: ONE real adult Colombian man in his early 30s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a pretty-boy idol face with flawless smooth skin, large clear eyes, a slim jaw and soft full lips, clean-shaven, silver foil-lined eyes with a cool shimmer, smooth golden-tan skin, a shy sweet smile, deep reddish mahogany-brown hair styled in natural curls gathered into a high rounded puff, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large gold hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (a silver pyramid-shaped lump, a gold barrel-shaped weight, a lead ship's anchor), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and seven to ten heavily stacked rose-gold anklets. Extremely long round nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
SUBJECT Physique: An extraordinarily large and powerful, classically muscular man, far beyond any real person, in the shape of a Greek statue. Wide shoulders, a full defined chest, a clean six-pack abdomen, strong rounded arms, and muscular thighs and calves, balanced and proportionate from head to toe, powerful and enormous. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
SUBJECT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a black ninja headband with a polished steel plate across his forehead, black fingerless wrist wraps, and a minimal black leopard-print T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him tied with a red sash at the hip, his chest and stomach bare.
SUBJECT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of his body.
SUBJECT Footwear: Extreme hot-pink platform stiletto slingbacks, the platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material reflecting the flash in sharp specular glints, the hard light carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, the face toward the camera.
